feature.name: Site Navigation & Language
feature.description: How a visitor reaches ALFEC's pages in French or English and moves between them: each page and each trade has its own URL, old single-page addresses redirect, the header and the mobile menu drawer lead to every section, the language link keeps the visitor on the same page, the home page runs an opening slideshow and opens the six trades as photo panels, trade pages link to each other, and gallery photos open a looping viewer. Rebuilt as a multi-page Astro site in September 2026 (Grands projets design).

surfaces.name: Page Request
surfaces.description: The HTTP request for a page. Every page has its own URL in French (no prefix) and English (/en/), with a trailing slash. Unknown paths answer 404 with a link home. The old single-page addresses (index.php, ?lg=, ?msg=) answer with redirects. Hosting redirects http and www to https://alfec.net.

actions.name: Request Non-Canonical Address
actions.intent: Hosting answers a request to http:// or www.alfec.net with a 301 to https://alfec.net, keeping the path and query string.

effects.description: Answered with a permanent redirect to the canonical address.

scenarios.name: www redirect
scenarios.description: www.alfec.net redirects permanently.

actions.name: Open Page
actions.intent: Load a page by its URL. French pages have no prefix and English pages start with /en/; the home, company, trades, each trade, projects, contact and the two confirmation pages all have their own address in both languages. A page opens with the menu and the viewer closed, the first opening photo and the Genie climatique panel open. An unknown address answers 404 with a link home.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Which page the URL names; unknown for an address the site does not have.

parameters.name: trade
parameters.description: The trade slug of a trade page (genie-climatique / hvac, and so on); none elsewhere or for an unknown slug.

surfaces.name: Site Chrome

acceptanceCriteria.title: Indexed URLs keep resolving
acceptanceCriteria.given: the addresses indexed for the old site: /, /index.php, /index.php?lg=fr and /index.php?lg=en, plus the old form's ?msg=success and ?msg=success_en
acceptanceCriteria.when: a crawler or a bookmark requests any of them
acceptanceCriteria.then: it reaches the matching page of the new site in the right language, directly or through a 301 (or a 303 for the old confirmation addresses)
acceptanceCriteria.description: Implemented by public/index.php; checked by tests/e2e/legacy.spec.ts.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Each language has its own title and description
acceptanceCriteria.then: it carries a title, a meta description and html lang in its own language, a canonical URL, hreflang links to its counterpart and to x-default, and appears in the sitemap with those alternates
acceptanceCriteria.description: Checked by tests/e2e/routes.spec.ts for all 22 pages.

acceptanceCriteria.title: All captured content stays available in both languages
acceptanceCriteria.given: the company facts and FR/EN copy in the audit (sections 7 and 8)
acceptanceCriteria.then: every fact and every trade, sector, competence and commitment text is still published in French and English
acceptanceCriteria.description: The redesign may restructure content, not drop it.
